summary: Completed public API and responsive UI testing for the monitoring dashboard. Health and overview APIs passed; dashboard loading, filtering, drawer actions, feedback toasts, navigation, and mobile sidebar flows were exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: Settings changes the heading and toast but does not receive the active navigation styling, unlike the other navigation items.
Resources and Logs buttons are clickable but do not change active state or displayed content; only Interfaces remains active.

issues: Recharts emits transient width(-1)/height(-1) warnings during initial render; chart recovered and rendered in the tested viewport.

action_items: Add active styling and/or a dedicated screen state for Settings.
Implement Resources and Logs tab state/content in the router detail drawer.
Consider guarding chart rendering until its container has non-zero dimensions to remove initial Recharts warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: RouterOS connection testing, console launching, and Telegram notifications are MOCKED/fallback UI feedback only; no real integrations are active without credentials and driver wiring.
The overview endpoint intentionally serves static demo data, so monitoring is not real-time despite the dashboard wording.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing demo/fallback router fleet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public health and monitoring overview passed. Search, group filters, navigation, action toasts, details drawer, connection/console feedback, and mobile sidebar passed. Recheck Settings active state and drawer Resources/Logs tabs after fixes; real RouterOS/Telegram flows remain untested and MOCKED.
rca of the issue: Settings uses the shared show() handler but its sidebar button has no active-class binding. Router drawer tabs are static buttons with no state or click handlers, so active styling/content cannot change. Recharts is mounted while its responsive parent is temporarily unmeasured during initial layout, producing width/height -1 warnings before recovery.
